subject: Four weeks of trial follow-up cannot establish an eight-week repeat-purchase effect for new trial entrants.
rationale: The target outcome spans eight weeks, while the proposed trial provides only four weeks of follow-up for new entrants. Later purchases remain unobserved, so those observations alone cannot establish the full eight-week effect. Extrapolation would require additional assumptions or evidence. This limitation follows from the observation window, without assuming the proposed trial occurred.
